period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from the bank's own 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited) As at 30 June 2015' and 'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited) For the period ended 30 June 2015' (each printed as its own statement alongside, and distinct from, the parallel Consolidated statements in the same filing), per project convention preferring Solo over Consolidated. Solo Total Property and Assets 210,662,414,328 vs Consolidated 217,735,492,532 (bKash/subsidiary consolidation effect ~7.07bn). Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: sum of Solo asset lines (19,541,858,556+25,149,382,604+250,000,000+19,280,582,108+128,531,499,896+2,943,648,528+14,965,442,636) = 210,662,414,328 = Total Liabilities 193,362,646,533 + Total shareholders' equity 17,299,767,795; equity sub-components (paid-up capital 7,092,873,210 + share premium 3,622,522,880 + statutory reserve 3,470,350,332 + revaluation reserve 582,862,056 + retained earnings 2,531,159,317) also sum exactly to 17,299,767,795. Income-statement items are Jan-to-June-2015 cumulative (Half-Yearly filing used as the Q2 data point per project convention); the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2015' column (Solo interest income 4,507,975,241; PAT 608,492,825; EPS 0.86) not recorded here. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII = interest income - interest expense; total operating income = NII + investment income + commission + other income; profit before provisions = total operating income - opex; PBT = profit before provisions - total provision; PAT = PBT - tax). 'borrowings' is a calculated sum of four reported liability lines (borrowings from other banks/FIs, borrowings from central bank, convertible subordinate bonds, money at call and short notice-liability), matching how the adjacent 2016_Q3/2017_Q1 solo filings for this bank represent the same concept. The bank's own 'Key Financial Indicators/Ratios' note (solo basis) independently corroborates deposits, loans and equity, and states 'Operating Profit' 3,498,791,232 equal to this P&L's 'Profit before provisions' line (no separate operating-profit subtotal exists in this document format, so operating_profit_cumulative below IS the profit-before-provisions figure); ROA 1.03%, ROE 12.23%, CAR 13.38% recorded as reported (the source does not mark these as annualized, unlike the 2017 filings for this bank which explicitly flag ROA/ROE/ROI as annualized - bear that caveat in mind for time-series comparison). The note's AD Ratio (78.40%) and ROI (6.55%) are bank-specific ratios not in the project's metric dictionary and not reproducible from simple loans/deposits arithmetic (128,531,499,896/142,382,259,601=90.3%, not 78.40%, implying a different regulatory AD-ratio definition), so left out as line items but recorded here for context. Dec-2014 comparative figures in this filing (Solo Total Property and Assets 204,593,071,725) match the same Dec-2014 date as later reported in the 2015_Q3 filing - no restatement detected.
